title: HELM executor observation (v1)
description: The body `helm-executor observe` posts to `POST {ORG}/observations`. It is evidence that a client hook saw a tool call. It is observed-only: it proves nothing about enforcement, and the client can drop, skip or fake it. The gateway's own records are the authority.

observed_at.description: When `observe` ran, UTC, millisecond precision. Not the client's event time.

episode_id.description: From the checked-out episode, never from the hook input.

work_item_id.description: From the checked-out episode, never from the hook input.

phase.description: before = PreToolUse, after = PostToolUse, failed = PostToolUseFailure. No success or failure is inferred from tool_response.

input_digest.description: SHA-256 of tool_input as JSON with object keys sorted and no whitespace.

input_summary.description: Optional. Bash: the shape of the command (programs and action words, no argument). Read, Edit, Write, MultiEdit, NotebookEdit and apply_patch: the path. Every other tool: omitted. Credential-shaped strings are also redacted.
